name: diagram
description: Draws the last mermaid diagram from Claude's answer as box art in a pane: run /diagram to open it. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and pie charts; offline, no model tokens.

hint.title: Hint after an answer with a diagram
hint.description: After an answer that contains a mermaid diagram, show one short line (at most once per turn) saying you can run /diagram to see it.
